notes.title: Large Titanic update! Fixes and more!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have updated Titanic to fix some issues! The changes are described below.

[h1]Additions And Changes:    [/h1]

[list]

[*]The lifeboats now do not go too far away from the Titanic. This is to reduce the chances of the player being flung out of them

[*]Ladders have been added to the stern of the Titanic. You can now explore the stern without being stuck at the back!

[*]We have changed the camera properties, there is now little to no clipping at all!

[*]When the Titanic sinks, the camera will now not wobble

[*]When you die, instead of being returned to the main menu, the level is reloaded (after the death screen)

[*]Player height has been decreased for easier movement

[*]Player jumping has also been decreased

[*]Updated text for the main menu and loading screen

[/list]

If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review!

notes.title: Titanic update has arrived! Interiors|New sinking and more!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Today the content update for Titanic has arrived!

[h1]Added:    [/h1]

Interiors for the grand staircase and turkish baths have been added. The turkish baths can be entered at the start of the ship, near the captains bridge. You just walk through the door and you will enter it. The grand staircase is entered through the wooden doors just after the 4th lifeboat from the start of the ship.

We have added a new scene, where you can see the Titanic sink from a lifeboat view.

A much slower sinking animation has been created for the Titanic as requested by the community. This gives the game a much more realistic feeling.

[h1]Changed: [/h1]

We have removed the ship travelling to Ireland as the scene for that was not smooth.

We re-arranged the dock for the first level

We added creaking sounds to the ship as it sank, as requested by the community.

We removed the exploring mode for the Titanic.

The jumping bug should now be 90% fixed.

New sounds added for the walking when the Titanic hits the iceberg level.
